name.zh: 一刀修罗的一分钟与史黛菈的燃天焚地龙王炎
name.en: Ittou Shura's one minute and Stella's knockdown

periods.location: Lava field at Osaka Bay Dome
periods.summary: Ikki rejects his fear, activates Ittou Shura, and challenges Stella to meet him in the center. The lovers abandon evasion and clash blade against blade as rivals, each growing in speed, force and technique. Ikki evolves Madoka into a muscle-chain return that no longer needs a full spin, but his inherent fate and magic capacity hit their limit; Stella continues evolving, overwhelms him, and strikes him out of the ring with Katharterio Salamandra before the ten-count begins.
periods.cause: Ikki realizes that no perfect opening exists against Stella and decides to pour everything into one minute of direct confrontation.
periods.outcome: The crowd and even Ikki's allies believe he has exhausted all possibility and lost, while Stella prepares to accept victory after the count.
periods.significance: Shows Ikki reaching the apparent end of his fate and Stella's talent outlasting even his total effort.
